purpose: Result-blind NSESche-only training test of a baseline-independent native clearance/response placement rule after the complete V187 throughput failure.

diagnostic_evidence.conclusion: V187's full response-time proxy over-weighted warm-start avoidance and became the primary high-density policy. It improved the composition of some completed requests but did not preserve completion volume. The next rule must separate CPU clearance from cold-start/transfer response time and keep clearance primary under congestion.

allowed_native_observations: parent output size and current bandwidth
current pending plus runnable tasks per node
method_identity_boundary.paper_attribution: The operational augmentation is an NSESche-native deterministic service-capacity rule; no comparator implementation is invoked or reproduced.

mechanistic_hypothesis.single_intervention: Replace V187's external-expert operational placement score by a native queue-adaptive service rule over the unchanged NSESche player frontier. Below 8 pending-plus-runnable tasks per node, rank candidates by complete current response time: parent transfer plus immutable cold start when not warm plus projected CPU clearance. At or above 8, use deterministic three-vote ordinal Borda with two votes for CPU clearance time excluding cold start and transfer, and one vote for the complete response-time proxy.
mechanistic_hypothesis.throughput_principle: CPU clearance counts all admitted remaining work, same-window projected work and the current player's immutable work divided by node capacity. Giving it the high-pressure majority prevents cold-start avoidance from serializing work on warm nodes and protects the number completed in the fixed observation window.
mechanistic_hypothesis.qpr_principle: The response vote retains warm reuse and parent locality only as a secondary high-pressure objective, while it is primary at low pressure where spare capacity makes latency and cold-start cost decisive.
mechanistic_hypothesis.fail_closed_fallback: If the complete feasible set lacks any required finite CPU-work, remaining-work, capacity, transfer, cold-start or parent-placement input, make the operational augmentation indifferent across all candidates and leave selection to the unchanged NSESche social-welfare state and deterministic node order.

cohort.training_reuse_disclosure: This is an adaptive training experiment on a previously revealed training cohort. Passing authorizes only a later disjoint confirmation; these rows cannot close the paper comparison.
cohort.reference_action: Build and bind twenty state-matched policy-independent references for the new candidate specifications.

disposition.on_pass: Freeze the candidate as a training winner named by paper experiment role and preregister a fresh disjoint low-load confirmation; do not claim closure from E1610-E1629.
disposition.on_fail: Retain all twenty valid runs, seal a failure receipt, close this native clearance/response axis, and continue low-load diagnosis without advancing to middle.
